summary: Declares that a run leaves a RECEIPT: written the moment it begins, holding a status that means nothing has been concluded yet, and rewritten exactly once when the run reports its end. The order is the mechanism -- a receipt written only at the end proves nothing about a run that never reached the end, and a run killed mid-way leaves artifacts that read exactly like finished ones. It is the LIFE half of observation and only that half: it records that a run fired, never that it hit. Whether the work was any good is a domain question, it is asked of cases and rubrics a host owns, and this capability deliberately ships no opinion about it. It is a sensor and never a broom: a record naming a run that died is evidence, and evidence is not swept up by the thing being questioned.
